claims.claim: Contrast therapy is simple in principle: heat your body thoroughly in a sauna, then immerse in cold water, and repeat.
claims.note: General description of contrast therapy; no venue record needed.

claims.claim: The physiological loop, blood vessels dilating, then constricting, then dilating again, is what most people are chasing.
claims.note: Physiological commentary; not a checkable venue claim.

claims.claim: Some of the places in this table are purpose-built bathhouses where contrast bathing is the whole point.
claims.note: Multiple venues have category 'bathhouse' in the records.

claims.claim: Others are hotel spas or gym facilities where a sauna and cold plunge sit alongside a broader offering.
claims.note: Waldheim Alpine Spa and Mineral Springs Hotel are category 'hotel_spa'; Hale Gym & Day Spa is category 'other'.

claims.claim: A dedicated bathhouse tends to build its pricing and session lengths around repeated cycles; a hotel spa might treat the circuit as a warm-up to a treatment.
claims.note: Generalised editorial observation, not a specific checkable claim.

claims.claim: A handful of venues here run both a traditional (Finnish-style) sauna and an infrared sauna.
claims.note: Onsen, Soak Bathhouse, Merse Wellness, My Recovery Lounge, Pond Bathhouse all have both infrared_sauna and traditional_sauna true.

claims.claim: Traditional saunas run hotter and work faster; infrared runs at lower temperatures and suits people who find the conventional heat hard to tolerate.
claims.note: General factual claim about sauna types, not tied to specific venue data.

claims.claim: My Recovery Lounge, for instance, offers a graduated option for beginners alongside a much more aggressive setting for experienced bathers.
claims.note: cold_plunge_display for My Recovery Lounge reads '2-3°C for experienced bathers, 7-9°C for beginners'.

claims.claim: Nova Holistic Spa and Waldheim Alpine Spa both require bookings in advance.
claims.note: Both venues have bookings_required: true in the records.

claims.claim: the others in this set don't [require bookings]
claims.note: All other venues have bookings_required: false.

claims.claim: Soak Bathhouse in South Yarra has a tiered structure where time of day and day of week affect the rate.

claims.claim: an early weekday visit costs noticeably less than a weekend evening.
